task_title: QA filing: ACCEPTANCE-PLAN mapping table still ends at section 37 after the CF-182 landing
task_criteria: Filing-only scope: the committed tree at HEAD adds exactly one board row CF-198 and the row carries a non-empty probe. From the repository root at HEAD run: jq -r 'select(.id=="CF-198") | .probe' .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl > /tmp/p198.sh; bash /tmp/p198.sh — expect selftest_sections=38, plan_says=38, mapping_last=37 and the DRIFT line naming the mapping table, exit 0. Also require bash tests/selftest.sh printing SELFTEST: PASS and bash scripts/boardctl validate printing RESULT: OK. Do NOT evaluate the repair (extending the mapping table and adding a derived checker); that is future work tracked by the pending row CF-198.
